summary: Fake-engine test leaks its temp directory when scan fails (panic before cleanup) and does not verify the real argument vector or the exit-code branches
evidence: clamav.rs:145 expect before remove_dir_all on line 146; fake script ignores $@; exit codes 0, 2 and empty-stderr branch untested
failure_scenario: Failing run leaves $TMPDIR/ochistka-clamav-<pid>; argv or exit-code regressions go undetected.
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
